title: Batch atlas car bodies by page and steered-tyre overlays in one pass when sprites cannot overlap
body:
Summary: Cars flushed the SpriteBatch up to twice per car per frame (body page, then the 1x1 tyre texture), 10-13 of ~24 draw calls in a race.
Description: WheelRig draws front-tyre overlays from its own 1x1 Texture and the ten classes live on two atlas pages, so the per-car body/tyre loop switched texture 2-12 times. New CarSprites pass: oriented body boxes (body_bounds_px) and tyre discs decide whether any tyre disc touches a LATER car body or two bodies on different pages touch. If not, bodies are grouped by page and all overlays follow in one batch; otherwise the original per-car order is kept, so pixels are identical either way.
Flow: drawWorld -> CarSprites.draw(batch, world, alpha): collect sprites; if n>1 build boxes/discs, test pairs; branch grouped / ordered / interleaved; counters batched/interleaved logged at dispose.
Expected impact: Draw calls and texture binds per race frame -6 each; on the Stick the P0 profile puts Mesh.render at 26% and glBufferData at 13% of render-thread time, i.e. per-flush driver cost dominates.
Evaluation:
- Claim: Draw calls/binds fall by about 6 per frame and the pass stays pixel-identical.
- Before: draw calls 26.5, binds 20.5 (A2 build, before this commit)
- After: draw calls 20.3, binds 14.3; batched path 2,843 of 3,585 frames, interleaved (grid/contact packs) 742
- Method: Desktop host, --hidden --soak --audit --profile, warm active frames (first 300 skipped), 50-60 s; counters are host-independent, desktop CPU ms are not Stick figures; ProfileGl counts glDrawElements/glBindTexture.
- Result: better
- Gate: tests green (game:test incl. tyre-disc geometry), procedural fallback untouched (unavailable body bounds -> original order); smoke screenshot checked
evidence: f3adc005; evidence in commit message; CarSprites.kt; RenderCullingTest.tyreDiscsFollowTheCarAndBoundTheOverlay

title: Cull off-screen pickups, mines, obstacles, effect decals and road quads before submission
body:
Summary: The renderer submitted every pickup, mine, obstacle, decal and the whole 360-sample road mesh each frame although the 1280x720 stage shows roughly a fifth of the course.
Description: ViewBounds (stage rectangle from focus and pixels-per-metre, 6 m slack) gates CombatPainter.ground, AtlasEffects.ground/air, ObstaclePainter shapes/sprites (radius incl. rotation and shadow offset) and TrackScene.draw (road quads chunked by 12 with precomputed bounds, drawn as visible runs; oil decals and gravel shortcuts gated). Default ViewBounds.ALL keeps audits unchanged.
Flow: drawWorld computes the camera, viewBounds.set(focus, ppm), then passes it to each painter; painters skip invisible items before any trig, rectLine or sprite work.
Expected impact: Fewer sprites/vertices and flushes; P0 Stick profile: TrackScene.draw 10.8%, CombatPainter.ground 5.1%, AtlasEffects.ground 3.0% of render-thread time.
Evaluation:
- Claim: Same picture, ~40% fewer sprite submissions.
- Before: culling off: draw calls 20.7, indices 20,403, binds 14.7, art.draw sprites 45.6/frame, cars/effects alloc 452 B/frame, sceneryDraw 0.024 ms, carsEffects 0.090 ms
- After: culling on: draw calls 16.7, indices 16,051 (-21%), binds 10.9, sprites 27.4/frame (-40%), alloc 36 B/frame, sceneryDraw 0.019 ms, carsEffects 0.059 ms
- Method: Desktop host, --hidden --soak --audit --profile, warm active frames (first 300 skipped), 50-60 s; counters are host-independent, desktop CPU ms are not Stick figures; same build toggled by a temporary property (removed).
- Result: better
- Gate: game:test green; smoke screenshots of lobby and race inspected; margins exceed sprite radius + shadow offset

title: Split the 10 Hz telemetry/UI refresh over three frames and build traffic/pickup JSON in one buffer
body:
Summary: Every sixth frame carried a ~50 KB, ~2 ms burst (P5 Stick: telemetryMs p50 0.006, p95 2.13, p99 2.94) which sits exactly on the p95 frame.
Description: The 10 Hz block now runs as stage 1 (audio/art/combat-summary JSON, slot HUD), stage 2 (traffic and pickup JSON via one reusable StringBuilder), stage 3 (rebuildUi HUD text layout) on consecutive frames. Same 10 Hz cadence; stats fields skew by at most two frames (33 ms).
Flow: render(): uiTime>=.1 -> uiStage 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 0.
Expected impact: Burst and p95 spike roughly halve; allocation per telemetry frame -42% mean, -62% worst.
Evaluation:
- Claim: Lower p95 frame work on the Stick and fewer GC-triggering spikes.
- Before: telemetry alloc mean 8,213 B/frame, worst 54,904 B, CPU p95 0.300 ms max 0.833 ms (culling build)
- After: mean 4,786 B, worst 21,104 B, CPU p95 0.147 ms, max 0.681 ms
- Method: Desktop host, --hidden --soak --audit --profile, warm active frames (first 300 skipped), 50-60 s; counters are host-independent, desktop CPU ms are not Stick figures; byte-identity of traffic/pickup JSON checked in-process over a 40 s soak (temporary check, removed).
- Result: better
- Gate: game:test green; JSON text identical

title: Retain the HUD minimap road line on the GPU
body:
Summary: drawMinimap submitted ~2,200 immediate-mode vertices (360 centre-line rectLines plus branches) every race frame; P0 Stick profile: drawMinimap 3.2% of render-thread time.
Description: SceneryCanvas owns a second RoadMarkMesh (shares the shader) baked once per scene from the same float formulas as rectLine; the shape pass is split around one mesh draw; immediate fallback if capacity is exceeded.
Flow: drawMinimap: bg rect -> shape.end -> scene.drawMinimapRoad (bake on first use) -> shape.begin -> car dots.
Expected impact: Per-frame CPU -34% on desktop for this call; Stick saving scales with the immediate-mode overhead measured there.
Evaluation:
- Claim: Lower CPU for the minimap at +2 draw calls.
- Before: legacy loop 14.98 us/frame (3 alternating pairs of 30 s soaks)
- After: mesh 9.87 us/frame; draw calls 24.3 -> 26.5
- Method: In-process A/B with a temporary toggle (removed); --profile counters.
- Result: better on CPU, worse on draw count (+2)
- Gate: game:test green; geometry/order identical to rectLine path (P5 pixel audit for the class)

title: Memoise CarShapes.forId in the renderer
body:
Summary: CarShapes.forId is a linear first{} scan (iterator + String.equals) called several times per car per frame; String.equals is the 3rd hottest render-thread self symbol in the P0 Stick profile (1.31%).
Description: CarShapeCache (HashMap) replaces the calls in RaceGame, CarPainter and the new pass.
Flow: render calls -> CarShapeCache.of(id).
Expected impact: Fewer String.equals and iterator allocations.
Evaluation:
- Claim: small
- Before: cars/effects alloc 482.8 B/frame
- After: 452.0 B/frame
- Method: Desktop host, --hidden --soak --audit --profile, warm active frames (first 300 skipped), 50-60 s; counters are host-independent, desktop CPU ms are not Stick figures
- Result: better (alloc only)
- Gate: game:test green

title: Cache pickup and ability-HUD atlas keys
body:
Summary: "pickups/"+id and "hud/ability-"+id were concatenated every frame.
Description: KeyCache(prefix).of(id).
Flow: AtlasEffects.ground, RaceGame HUD.
Expected impact: Allocation only.
Evaluation:
- Claim: HUD alloc to zero.
- Before: HUD phase 65.8 B/frame, cars/effects 482.8 B/frame; allocation audit 9,484 B/frame (31.23 MB / 3,293 frames)
- After: HUD 0.08 B/frame, cars/effects 32.1 B/frame; audit 4,971 B/frame (16.31 MB / 3,282 frames, whole chain)
- Method: Desktop host, --hidden --soak --audit --profile, warm active frames (first 300 skipped), 50-60 s; counters are host-independent, desktop CPU ms are not Stick figures
- Result: better
- Gate: game:test green

title: Validate the render chain on the Stick (frame p95, flush count)
body:
Summary: All six render commits are measured on the desktop host with GPU-independent counters only; the target is Stick frame p95 16.7 ms (now ~20-21).
Description: Run tools/perf-device.py with the APK built from this branch against the P5 baseline (same scheduling variant), collect draw calls, binds, workMs, telemetryMs p95 and frame interval.
Flow: build APK -> install -> 360 s race soak -> perf-summary.
Expected impact: Expected from counters: draw calls 24.5 -> 16.3, binds 20.5 -> 10.4, telemetry p95 2.1 -> ~1 ms.
Evaluation:
- Claim: Stick workMs p95 falls by >= 1.5 ms.
- Before: P5 profile: workMs mean 8.51 p95 12.77; drawCalls mean 16.5 (cached marks); telemetryMs p95 2.13
- After: unmeasured (no Stick access in this round)
- Method: device run
- Result: pending
- Gate: frame p95 and workMs not worse than P5 in the same arm

title: Disable GL blending for the opaque scenery and road draws (PowerVR hidden-surface removal)
body:
Summary: drawWorld enables blending for the whole frame; the scenery region quad and road tiles are opaque but are blended in submission order, which defeats HSR on the PowerVR GPU (libGLESv2_powervr in the P0 profile).
Description: Call batch.disableBlending() around scene.draw, re-enable after; check that road tile edges and region tints stay identical (alpha-1 tiles only).
Flow: scene.draw: disableBlending -> draw -> enableBlending.
Expected impact: Fragment shading cost of the ground layers roughly halves if HSR engages.
Evaluation:
- Claim: Fragment shading cost of the ground layers roughly halves if HSR engages.
- Before: Stick sceneryDrawMs mean 1.29 ms p95 1.89 ms (P5).
- After: Stick A/B
- Method: sceneryDraw phase and GPU time via the existing profile
- Result: pending
- Gate: sceneryDrawMs lower, screenshot diff zero
evidence: P5 profile phases; PowerVR driver frames in P0 callgraph

title: Serve /stats JSON lazily instead of building it on the render thread
body:
Summary: The render thread still builds audio/art/combat-summary/traffic/pickup strings at 10 Hz (4.8 KB/frame amortised) that only /stats readers use.
Description: RaceServer would take Supplier<String> for the five stats fields (link/ is another stream) and the render thread would only publish a reference to the live world snapshot.
Flow: link change + RaceGame stops building strings.
Expected impact: Render-thread telemetry allocation to ~0 and telemetry spike removed.
Evaluation:
- Claim: Render-thread telemetry allocation to ~0 and telemetry spike removed.
- Before: telemetry alloc 4,774 B/frame mean, 21,112 B worst
- After: ~0
- Method: allocation audit
- Result: pending
- Gate: /stats byte-compatible, probes unchanged

title: Remove the tyre-overlay texture swap by adding a white texel region to the cars atlas page
body:
Summary: CarSprites keeps the per-car order in 743 of 3,574 frames (21%: grid and contact packs) because the overlay texture differs from the page.
Description: assets/ stream adds a 2x2 opaque white region (with padding) to cars-0/1 pages and metadata; WheelRig draws overlays from it; CarSprites ordering logic can then be dropped.
Flow: assets -> WheelRig.init.
Expected impact: Draw calls in contact packs -6; simplifies the pass.
Evaluation:
- Claim: Draw calls in contact packs -6; simplifies the pass.
- Before: interleaved frames 21%
- After: 0%
- Method: soak counters
- Result: pending
- Gate: asset pack validator passes

title: Merge the three HUD font pages and the UI atlas into fewer texture pages
body:
Summary: Race HUD flushes four times (UI atlas, then three GlyphLayer fonts) per frame.
Description: Pack the three runtime fonts into one page or one SDF page; assets/ and RuntimeFonts own it.
Flow: HUD batch.
Expected impact: HUD draw calls 4 -> 2.
Evaluation:
- Claim: HUD flushes
- Before: 4
- After: 2
- Method: profile counters
- Result: pending
- Gate: text pixel diff zero

title: Retain the static HUD frame/panel layer as one textured quad
body:
Summary: Panels, nine-patch frames and bars are redrawn every frame (hudMs mean 1.37 ms, p95 2.17 ms on the Stick, P5).
Description: Render the static HUD chrome into a retained 1280x720 texture on phase change and draw one quad; text and meters stay live.
Flow: phase change -> rebake.
Expected impact: HUD CPU and flush count down.
Evaluation:
- Claim: HUD CPU and flush count down.
- Before: hudMs 1.37 ms
- After: unmeasured
- Method: Stick A/B
- Result: pending
- Gate: pixel diff and hudMs

title: Precomputed unit-ring tables for CombatPainter.ring, AbilityPainter.ring and seatRing
body:
Summary: Each ring segment computes cos/sin twice (JNI intrinsic calls on ART) for 20-24 rectLines; CombatPainter.ring was 3.63% of Stick render-thread time before culling.
Description: Static DoubleArray/FloatArray tables with the same expressions give identical values.
Flow: painters index the table.
Expected impact: Trig calls per ring 48 -> 0; after culling few rings remain so the gain is now small.
Evaluation:
- Claim: <1% of render time
- Before: 48 trig calls/ring
- After: 0
- Method: micro-benchmark
- Result: not measured here
- Gate: pixel-identical

title: Memoise AtlasArt.available/region lookups
body:
Summary: available() and region() hash and String.equals up to four times per draw; AtlasArt.carKey 0.64%, available 0.38%, region 0.37% in the pre-cull Stick profile.
Description: Resolve per key once after init (regions never change afterwards) in an identity-keyed map.
Flow: AtlasArt.
Expected impact: ~1% of render time before culling, less now.
Evaluation:
- Claim: ~1%
- Before: several String.equals per draw
- After: 1 identity lookup
- Method: Stick profile
- Result: pending
- Gate: tests green, fallback intact

title: Draw the minimap road mesh without splitting the overlay shape pass
body:
Summary: The retained minimap costs +2 draw calls because the shape pass is split around it.
Description: Draw the minimap background and road in the mesh before the shape pass and clip the atmosphere particles/vignette over its rectangle (owner visual decision: vignette currently draws under the opaque minimap).
Flow: overlay.
Expected impact: -2 draws.
Evaluation:
- Claim: 2 draws
- Before: +2
- After: 0
- Method: profile counters
- Result: pending
- Gate: owner accepts identical look

title: Rebuild HUD text only when a string changes
body:
Summary: rebuildUi relays out all three glyph layers every 100 ms (about 4.7 KB per rebuild) although most race HUD strings are stable between ticks.
Description: Build into a scratch layer, compare vertex hash, swap on change (HUD text is outside this round's write boundary for layout, hence lane B).
Flow: stage 3.
Expected impact: Alloc and layout work per second down.
Evaluation:
- Claim: Alloc and layout work per second down.
- Before: 4.7 KB x 10 Hz
- After: ~1 KB
- Method: allocation audit
- Result: pending
- Gate: text unchanged
